text:
Alana: Heads-up — compact interviewer prep kits we uploaded yesterday aren't showing in the candidate scheduler panel for a handful of reqs (us-east). Candidates see 'Prep kit pending' and interviewers can't access PDFs. Anyone else seeing this? Example: req #5421. :thinking_face:
Mike: Seen it, thanks. I can repro. Panel view shows empty iframe. Quick check: S3 object exists and link returns 200.
Jordan: I grabbed logs — webhook delivery to ATS succeeded but the 'prep_url' field is null in the ATS panel response. Screenshot: https://redwood-internal.screens/abc123.png
Sasha: Could be the new compact kit prefix change we applied (kit_v2_). ATS mapping expects 'prep_kit_url' not 'prep_url' — did we change the payload schema? @Mike
Mike: We did change the field name in the batch upload manifest to 'prep_url' to align with our new uploader. Oops. The ATS integration is still reading 'prep_kit_url'.
Ben R: Can we hotfix at integration layer to support both keys? I can patch recruiter-service to fallback to either field. ETA ~2h. :thumbsup:
recruit-bot: deploy triggered by Ben R: patch/recruiter-service/allow-prep-url-fallback — build 672 -> staging ✅
Alana: Thanks. Workaround in meantime: share public GDrive link with interviewers for req 5421. I'll DM teams. Also flagging for comms.
Jordan: Patch looks good on staging. Patch log snippet:
```
2026-03-23T15:42:01Z INFO reading prep fields, prep_kit_url=null, prep_url='https://s3.amazonaws.com/redwood-prep/kit_v2_5421.pdf' 
```
No more nulls.
recruit-bot: deploy completed to production by Ben R: build 672 -> prod ✅
Sasha: Confirmed on prod: panel now shows kit for req 5421. Can everyone verify other affected reqs? I'll run a quick query for any payloads where both keys missing.
Mike: Running query now — found 7 more hits between 2026-03-22T22:10:00Z and 2026-03-22T23:30:00Z PST. I'll create a backfill job to re-sync those reqs' payloads.
Alana: Awesome. Please add a short postmortem to #people-ops with root cause & action items. I'll handle comms to hiring managers. Thanks team :party-parrot:
